About Us

Three decades
of crafting comfort.

Founded in 1990, V.K. Bajaj & Co. — known across the trade by its house name Angel Lingeries — is among India’s largest manufacturers of ladies’ innerwear.

Over 35 years we have built a fully integrated house — designing, moulding, bonding and finishing entirely in-house — that today serves many of the country’s leading retail chains alongside established export markets.

Across 35 years of steady growth, our commitment to fit, finish and fabric has never changed. Every garment that leaves our floor reflects that commitment — the reason our name is trusted on retail shelves nationwide.

Origin

Founded in
1990.

V.K. Bajaj & Co. — known across the trade by its house name Angel Lingeries.

Founded in 1990, V.K. Bajaj & Co. — known across the trade by its house name Angel Lingeries — is among India’s largest manufacturers of ladies’ innerwear.

Over 35 years we have built a fully integrated house — designing, moulding, bonding and finishing entirely in-house — that today serves many of the country’s leading retail chains alongside established export markets.

Across 35 years of steady growth, our commitment to fit, finish and fabric has never changed. Every garment that leaves our floor reflects that commitment — the reason our name is trusted on retail shelves nationwide.

Today, two dedicated units, a 400-strong team and the country’s largest in-house foam-moulding capacity let us combine the reliability of scale with the care of a specialist house — serving retail floors across India and export markets including Russia, Dubai and Saudi Arabia for over 15 years.

Our Purpose

Everyday comfort,
made dependable.

To manufacture innerwear that women reach for every day — consistent in fit, honest in quality and fairly priced — while being a partner our retail customers can plan around with confidence.

Home / Quality

Quality & Compliance

Quality you can audit, not just trust.

In-line and end-line checks with AQL inspection before every dispatch — plus SEDEX 4-Pillar certification, so large retailers can place programmes on a factory that is safe, ethical and fully audit-ready.

Certifications

Audit-ready, by design.

SX

SEDEX 4-Pillar

Certified since 2024 for ethical, safe and responsible manufacturing — ready for global retail programmes.

EX

State Export Award

Recognised for contribution to garment exports from the region.

QC

In-house QC System

In-line and end-line checks with AQL inspection and defect tracking.

Why it matters

A compliance-ready partner.

For large retailers, a supplier is only as good as its weakest audit. Our compliance posture means onboarding is smoother, programmes are lower-risk, and your teams spend less time managing exceptions.

SEDEX membership has been held since 2024 across the four-pillar framework — labour standards, health & safety, environment and business ethics — covering both production units.

The Control Plan

Five gates between
fabric and carton.

01 Incoming material check Fabric, lace, elastic and trim are inspected on receipt — GSM, stretch recovery, shade and shrinkage against the approved standard.
02 In-line inspection Inspectors sit on the stitching lines, catching seam, tension, measurement and attachment faults at the point they occur — not at the end.
03 Cup & bond integrity Moulded cups are checked for shape retention and delamination; bonded seams are pull-tested against the approved bond strength.
04 AQL end-line audit Every lot is sampled to AQL before packing, with defect classification and tracking feeding back to the line that produced it.
05 Retail-ready packing Retail-ready packing, barcoding and carton marking to buyer spec — so stock lands shelf-ready rather than needing rework at the DC.

Documentation

Audit packs, test reports, compliance certificates and inspection records are available on request as part of supplier onboarding.

Traceability

Each lot carries a production record — fabric lot, line, operator batch and inspection result — so a query can be traced back to source.

Compliance

Social-compliance and factory-safety documentation is maintained for both units and refreshed ahead of each audit cycle.

Need our compliance pack for a supplier onboarding review? We can send the current documentation directly.
